journeyIntro: A simplified view of the privacy risks people can face online — and the privacy-first direction we are exploring with SafeMobile.
journeyStep1Text: When you use an app or service, information may travel across networks and services.
journeyStep2Text: Third-party trackers and profiling technologies may observe activity across apps and websites.
journeyStep3Text: SafeMobile now has a signed Android build with local inspection, limited static indicators and user-directed response tools. Detection performance is still being validated; public Google Play availability is not confirmed.
journeyStep4Text: Clear choices, privacy-conscious defaults and transparent controls should keep people in charge.
journeyFootnote: This overview describes the current development direction, not certified protection, guaranteed detection or confirmed public availability.

safeSubtitle: On-device Malware Scanning. Ad-supported Free Tier. No AdMob Ads with Pro.
safeTags: Android 8.0+ · Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Privacy-first security
safeReleaseNote: A signed v1.9.0 Android App Bundle is published as a release artifact and prepared for Play Console submission. This does not confirm public Google Play availability.
safeFeaturesDesc: A local-first security design with clear capability boundaries. Detection coverage is limited and remains under validation.
safeFeature1Desc: Local SHA-256 matching (the bundled offline definition currently contains only the harmless EICAR test marker) plus static DEX inspection through a bounded Kotlin YARA-compatible rule subset. The five bundled rules are limited and their matches are advisory; this is not full YARA.
safeFeature2Desc: A five-second alarm-stream siren, security notification and user-confirmed Android uninstall flow. Audio and notification delivery remain subject to Android permissions, Do Not Disturb and OEM background policies.
safeFeature3Desc: Inspects Accessibility services, Device Administrator apps, notification listeners and overlay permissions. These are device-risk signals, not proof that an app is malicious.
safeFeature4Desc: 51 bundled locale resource folders, Light, Midnight and OLED themes, and screen-reader-friendly Compose accessibility semantics.
safeFeature5Desc: OFF by default. Optional, user-approved contribution submits a SHA-256 threat indicator; the local source locator is excluded from the HTTP payload. APK bytes and scan history are not uploaded.
safeFeature6Desc: GitHub Actions ingests pre-extracted 215-feature research rows dispatched by the app, validates schema and holdout metrics, and promotes only eligible candidates. Scheduled validation does not automatically publish a new model.
safeFeature7Desc: The Free tier uses consent-gated Google AdMob advertising, including banners. An active local Pro entitlement blocks AdMob initialization and ad requests.
safeFeature8Desc: ₹299 annual India list price, subject to the active Google Play offer. Pro access is cached locally in an encrypted, device-bound 365-day entitlement with a one-day grace buffer. No developer cloud account or cloud backup is provided.
safeFeature9Desc: App-private encrypted quarantine uses Tink Streaming AEAD with an Android Keystore-wrapped keyset, guided restore and user-controlled removal. The original file is not silently deleted.
safeArchitectureDesc: The implementation separates local detection, signed intelligence, experimental ML and private persistence. Each layer has explicit limits.
safeArchitectureCapability1: Local SHA-256 matching (the bundled offline definition is currently the harmless EICAR test marker only) and limited DEX/YARA-compatible signatures. Limitation: no kernel privilege; Android sandbox and package-visibility restrictions apply.
safeArchitectureCapability2: Optional cryptographically verified SHA-256 hash-definition updates. Limitation: online retrieval is optional, network-dependent and requires a configured trust root.
safeArchitectureCapability3: SHA-256-pinned, 215-feature TFLite trained research candidate. Limitation: validated=false; no production ML classifications.
safeArchitectureCapability4: Local scan history in Room/DataStore and Keystore-backed sensitive records. Limitation: no developer-operated cloud account or developer-controlled backup.
safeArchitectureNote: The Android app has no kernel privilege. Static inspection does not execute APK code and cannot observe every runtime, packed, native or dynamically loaded behaviour.
safeBenchmarkDesc: Industry Benchmark #11 — verified 31 October 2026. The active scanner did not return confirmed detections for this particular malicious-source cohort. SUSPICIOUS is triage, not a confirmed threat.
safeBenchmarkFootnote: The cohort contained 100 source-labelled malicious APKs and 100 benign APKs. Source labels are not independently adjudicated ground truth, and the research ML candidate scored zero samples in this run. These corpus- and build-specific measurements are not certification or a guarantee of protection.

safeTeaserDescription: A privacy-first Android security app with local inspection, limited static threat indicators and a continuously evaluated ML research pipeline. Signed build v1.9.0 is published on GitHub; public Google Play availability is not yet confirmed.
safeCardMultiDesc: Local SHA-256 checks and bounded DEX inspection through five Kotlin YARA-compatible rules. The bundled offline hash is currently EICAR-only; rule matches are advisory, not full YARA detection.
safeCardIncidentDesc: A five-second alarm-stream siren, security notification and user-confirmed uninstall flow. Android permissions, Do Not Disturb and OEM background rules can affect alert delivery.
safeCardPrivacyDesc: Core scans and history stay on-device. Optional user-approved threat contribution sends a SHA-256 indicator only; private quarantine is encrypted and user-controlled.
safeCardProDesc: ₹299 annual India list price, subject to the active Google Play offer. Active Pro entitlement excludes AdMob; access is cached locally in an encrypted device-bound entitlement.
